description:
Aviation Intelligence — the Avic Air podcast

For aviators, everyday points of frustration can mean life or death. This show takes aviation's tactics — the debrief, the checklist, the crew brief — and applies them to streamline your life, strengthen your relationships, and advance any career, in any industry.

Root cause analysis keeps finding the same thing: the human element is the number one cause of incidents, accidents, and revenue loss. We dissect the complex factors behind the two little words at the end of most crash reports — "pilot error" — and hunt for the solutions upstream of them.

From both sides of the hiring table and every corner of the industry, we cover what actually moves an aviation career and an aviation business:

  • Interview prep — what recruiters really probe, and why authenticity beats memorized answers
  • Checkride failure avoidance — never walk into a ride as a gamble, and how to come back stronger if you have
  • Leadership & command training — CRM, decision making, and the crews people want to fly with
  • Aircraft insurance — how underwriters read risk, and how a documented training record changes the conversation
  • Aircraft brokering — buying and selling smart, with training and insurance baked into the deal
  • The human skills underneath it all: minimizing stress and distraction, mastering negotiation and compromise, resolving conflict, motivating a team, overcoming your psychological and physiological limits, and turning small talk into great conversations

Aeronautical jargon is minimized and explained — these principles apply to any industry and any situation.

Aviation looks glamorous on digital media, but it demands sacrifice beyond belief, and succeeding means accepting more risk than any "normal" human would consider. Most great success is born out of frustration — so we're sharing the things that keep us up at night. This commercial-free podcast is dedicated to igniting those thoughtful sparks into actionable flames, shaping the industry into a more prosperous place for all.

Scaling Aviation Safety — safety is a byproduct of a series of safe behaviors.

title: RIZE365

description:
Welcome to RIZE365.


This is a podcast where you and I explore what it means to stop living for worth and start living from worth.

I’m not an expert. I’m simply a man on a journey, and I’m inviting you to walk beside me.

For most of my life, I believed my worth had to be earned. I thought I had to achieve more, perform better, and become someone worthy of love, acceptance, and significance. Looking back, I realize that belief wasn’t random it was the operating system my younger self installed to survive.

We all have an internal operating system.

It’s made up of the beliefs and assumptions we develop throughout childhood. Some of those beliefs help us survive difficult seasons, but they aren’t always meant to guide us for the rest of our lives.

My childhood was marked by profound loss and instability. Those experiences shaped the way I saw myself and the world around me. They taught me to believe that my value depended on what I could do rather than who I already was.

That operating system helped me survive.

But it can no longer help me become the man I want to be.

So I’m installing a new operating system.

Each week, I’ll share what I’m learning as I replace my old way of living with a new foundation built on what I call “The RIZE Path”


Worth → Identity → Purpose → Growth → Love → Service


Because if you don’t know your worth, you’ll never fully know your identity.

If you don’t know your identity, you’ll struggle to discover your purpose.

Without purpose, growth loses direction.

Without growth, love becomes limited by fear.

And without love, service becomes performance instead of a gift.

This isn’t a podcast about becoming someone new.

It’s about uncovering the person you were always created to be.

So wherever you are on your journey, welcome.

Let’s discover together what it looks like to live from worth instead of spending our lives trying to earn it.

title: Rebuild After Grief | Widow, Loneliness, Faith, Encouragement, Scripture
author: Shonna Gaston - Rebuilding Coach, Encourager for Christian Widows
description:
Are you a Christian widow?
Do you wish the loneliness would go away once and for all?
Are you exhausted from making all the decisions by yourself?
Do you feel like you’re in survival mode, just trying to make it through the day and not lose your faith?
Are you scared to ask for help?
Would it be easier to be there for your kids if they understood what you’re going through? 
I’m so glad you’re here! As you navigate life after loss, this podcast will help you model faith and courage for your children, make it through each day, and learn to let go of what you can’t control. 
Hi, I’m Shonna, a widow, mom, grandma, and Jesus follower. For seven years after becoming a widow, I battled loneliness in all the wrong ways. 
When I suddenly became the sole decision-maker, I was lost and made some very bad decisions because I felt no one understood what I was going through and I wouldn’t dare be vulnerable and ask for help. 
I finally realized if I was ever going to enjoy life again and model faith well for my family, I needed to find out who I was as an individual according to God’s design, then align my life with his purpose. 
I started intentionally connecting with God each day and over the course of time, my mind was renewed and I became strong again. And now I am ready to share it with you! 
So, if you’re ready to overcome the loneliness you’ve felt since becoming a widow, learn some simple habits to strengthen your faith, and become the best you can be for your children...Grab a notebook and your favorite flashy pen and let’s dive in!

title: The Irish Military History Podcast
author: Joseph Quinn
description:
Welcome to the Irish Military History Podcast!


This is brand new podcast series that will explore Ireland’s boundlessly rich military history, and will examine the unique social and cultural history of the Irish at war. 


Every fortnight, we will release an episode covering a unique aspect of this amazingly diverse and fascinating history, and will share with you the remarkable personal stories of Irish people, men and women, soldiers and civilians, who experienced war and conflict on these shores, and far beyond…


And when we say far beyond, we mean global. We will follow Ireland’s military story to the far corners of the earth, accompanying Irishmen and women who served in the armies, navies and air forces of Britain, France, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa in conflicts all over the world.


And that’s just the modern era… we’re also going to march into battle alongside Irish emigrant soldiers who went into foreign service on the continent of Europe during the 17th, 18th and 19th centuries, following the stories of Irish troops who enrolled in the service of Britain, France, Spain, the Papal States, Austria, Prussia and even Russia. 


We will also be delving into domestic military history, interrogating the history of Ireland’s many centuries of rebellions, uprisings, wars and revolutions, spanning from the Middle Ages right up to the Twentieth Century, which mark out the course of the long Irish struggle for independence and freedom from English and British rule. 


But so too will we be taking an interest in the experience of British, and other foreign personnel, who served in Ireland during various periods, and how they interacted with the Irish population. We will cast light, not just on the flashpoints of conflict and violence that define the relationship between the Irish people and their foreign occupiers, but also the special moments of cohesion and of friendship that ultimately led to the development of Irish society, and that changed the course of Irish history.


In short, we have an endless list of topics to explore!


Tune into the Irish Military History Podcast on Acast, ITunes, Spotify, Apple Podcasts or wherever you get your podcasts.

title: Brewing
author: Alfred Chaston Chapman
description: Great as is the debt of gratitude which the brewing industry owes to the labours of scientific men, it has been more than repaid by the immense services which that industry has indirectly rendered to the advancement of modern science. It may be said without exaggeration that in respect of the number of scientific investigations of the first order of importance to which it has given rise, the brewing industry stands easily preeminent among the industries of mankind, and that without the stimulus furnished by the desire to arrive at the meaning of some of the more important phenomena connected with the brewing of beer, both chemical and biological science would probably be the poorer today by some of their most valued intellectual achievements. . . . The brewing of beer is regarded by many as an operation of a simple and more or less mechanical description, which is not of sufficient importance to merit study or of sufficient interest to claim a share of their attention. It is in the hope of doing something, even though it be but little, to correct this widely spread impression, that I have most willingly accepted the invitation to contribute this little work to The Cambridge Manuals of Science and Literature. From the Preface.

title: The Great Wealth Transfer
author: Ali Katz
description:
Between now and 2048, roughly $124 trillion will pass between generations. Most people assume that's a billionaire story. It isn't. Nearly half of it moves through ordinary families with a home, a retirement account, a small business, some land, and no plan.
The Great Wealth Transfer is about what happens to that money, and what it takes to make sure it reaches the people you love instead of disappearing before it gets there.
Host Ali Katz has spent twenty years as a Personal Family Lawyer and Family Wealth Advisor. She began her career at Charlie Munger's law firm building the legal and financial machinery that keeps the wealthiest families in America wealthy, then spent the next two decades making that same infrastructure available to everyone else.
Each episode takes on the things families get wrong about money and rarely talk about out loud. Why estate planning fails when it's built for death instead of life. How the cost of long-term care quietly eats an inheritance before anyone notices. What a trust actually does, and why the best time to use one is while an asset is still small enough to ignore. Why the feeling that you're bad with money was installed, and who profits from it. And how to have the conversation with your parents, or your children, while everyone is still here to have it.
This is not about becoming rich enough to matter. It's about deciding that what you already have is worth seeing.
New episodes weekly.

title: Six Books of Proclus, the Platonic Successor, on the Theology of Plato

description: The Six books of Proclus, the Platonic successor, on The Theology of Plato (Greek: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΚΑΤΑ ΠΛΑΤΩΝΑ ΘΕΟΛΟΓΙΑΣ; Latin: Theologia Platonica; Alternate English Title: Platonic Theology) to which a Seventh book is added by the translator, Thomas Taylor, in order to supply the deficiency of another book on this subject, which was written by Proclus, but since lost. According to the 1995 Prometheus Trust edition Book 3 Chapter 1 of this translation contains Chapters 1-4 from the original Greek, Chapter 2 contains the Greek chapters 5-6 and Chapter 3 contains the Greek Chapters 7-8. Thereafter, the translated and Greek chapters match beginning at Chapter 9. title: Hexaemeron
author: Basil of Caesarea
description: The Hexaemeron is the title of nine homilies delivered by St. Basil on the the cosmogony of the opening chapters of Genesis. When and where they were delivered is quite uncertain. They are Lenten sermons, delivered at both the morning and evening services, and appear to have been listened to by working men. (Hom. iii. 1) Some words in Hom. viii. have confirmed the opinion that they were preached extempore, in accordance with what is believed to have been Basil's ordinary practice. Internal evidence points in the same direction for though a marked contrast might be expected between the style of a work intended to be read, like the De Spiritu Sancto, and that of the orations to be spoken in public, the Hexaemeron shews signs of being and unwritten composition. In earlier ages, it was the most celebrated and admired of Basil's works. Photius (Migne, Pat. Gr. cxli) puts it first of all, and speaks warmly of its eloquence and force. As an example of oratory he would rank it with the works of Plato and Demosthenes. (Introduction by Nicene Post-Nicene Fathers, Series II, Vol. VIII)

title: Exodus, from Horae Homileticae
author: Charles Simeon
description: Simeon's Works, as they were published 1832, fill twenty-one large octavo volumes, and the title-page reads, "Horae Homileticae or Discourses (principally in the form of Skeletons) now first digested into one continued Series and forming a Commentary upon every book of the Old and New Testament ; to which is annexed an improved Edition of a Translation of Claude's Essay on the Composition of a Sermon". It was the literary achievement of his life, and no unworthy one. These volumes, now long out of print, contain many discourses fully written, among them the several sets of University Sermons; but the large majority of the more than two thousand compositions are précis of parochial sermons, well ordered outlines of exposition, arranged according to the books of the Holy Scriptures. The reader, as the author warns him, will look there in vain for minute criticism or for remote speculation ; but he will seldom fail to gather excellent suggestions how to explain and arrange, and how to carry messages home from the Word of God to the life of man. The term "Skeleton" was certainly unfortunate - Simeon's despisers made merry over it. But the summaries so named were no pieces of lifeless mechanism, as their author planned them, and as he taught others how to use them. They were the bone-systems of sermons which he himself made to live, and speak, and work; and he did his utmost to teach 'his young men' how to do the same. - Summary by Handley Carr Glyn Moule

title: Principles of Economics, The Appendices
author: Alfred Marshall
description: Principles of Economics was a leading economics textbook of Alfred Marshall (1842-1924), first published in 1890. Marshall began writing the book in 1881, and he spent much of the next decade at work on it.His plan for the work gradually extended to a two-volume compilation on the whole of economic thought; the first volume was published in 1890 to worldwide acclaim that established him as one of the leading economists of his time. It brought the ideas of supply and demand, of marginal utility and of the costs of production into a coherent whole, and became the dominant economic textbook in England for a long period. The second volume, which was to address foreign trade, money, trade fluctuations, taxation, and collectivism, was never published at all. (Summary from Wikipedia)This reading is based on the eighth edition, published in 1920.

My mission is to encourage and equip Christian women with chronic illness to pursue God’s calling with wisdom and courage—one faithful step at a time
.
So if you’re ready to stop measuring your life by a pace that no longer suits you and start embracing what God can and still wants to do through you, you’re in the right place.
I’m Melodie, a Jesus-following wife, Christian life & rhythm guide, and certified Enneagram coach. For years, I lived in a cycle of pushing through fatigue, crashing, and trying harder to reclaim the life I used to have.
Then God gently showed me that I didn’t need to get my old life back. I needed to learn how to live faithfully in the life He had given me now. 
As I began building rhythms shaped by Scripture, beauty, and a deeper understanding of how God had uniquely designed me, my clarity returned, my creativity reawakened, and my confidence in His leading grew stronger than ever.
Now I have the joy of walking alongside other God-led women who long to keep pursuing the dreams He has entrusted to them—even with limited strength.
If you’re ready to flourish with chronic illness and discover the peace and purpose found in wholehearted, sustainable living, this podcast is for you.

title: Empresses of Rome
author: Joseph Martin McCabe
description: The story of Imperial Rome has been told frequently and impressively in our literature, and few chapters in the long chronicle of man’s deeds and failures have a more dramatic quality. The fresh aspect of this familiar story which I propose to consider is the study of the women who moulded or marred the succeeding Emperors. Woman had her part in the making, as well as the unmaking, of Rome. Long before the commencement of our era, the thought and the power of the Roman woman went out into the larger world of public life; and when the Empire is founded, when the control of the State’s mighty resources is entrusted to the hands of a single ruler, the wife of the monarch may share his power, and assuredly shares his interest for us. Roman women were not content to be secluded from the new culture, and could not escape the stimulation of their new world. An inscription found at Lanuvium, where the Empress Livia had a villa, shows that the little provincial town had a curia mulierum, a women’s debating club. The walls of Pompeii, when the shroud of lava had been removed from its scorched face, bore election-addresses signed by women. As single figures and types rising to the luminous height of the throne out of the dark and indistinguishable crowd, they deserve to be passed in review. (Summary taken from the author's introduction)

title: Complete Works of Brann, The Iconoclast, Volume 12

description: William Cowper Brann earned the nickname “The Iconoclast” by fearlessly attacking established beliefs and institutions which he thought to be pompous and self-serving. During this period, Catholics and Protestants were duking it out over the soul of Texas and there was even further sectarian strife among Protestants. Brann wrote prolifically and aired his Politically Incorrect views with vigor and colorful language. Described as a “slouch-hatted, gun-toting, beer-drinking, woman-worshiping man,” he assailed Baptists, Prohibition, blacks and universities as though engaged in a life-or-death gunfight; and actually he was killed in a gunfight at age 43. After he was shot in the back, drew his own gun and killed the man who had bushwacked him AND THEN walked directly to the jail before dying the next morning. This Volume 12 consists mainly of newspaper editorials and accounts of his death. Here you'll find both praise for his work and criticisms of his junk-yard-dog style of attack journalism. title: Kojiki: Records of Ancient Matters
author: no Are Hieda, no Yasumaro Ō
description: Of all the mass of Japanese literature, which lies before us as the result of nearly twelve centuries of book-making, the most important monument is the work entitled Kojiki (古事記) or Records of Ancient Matters, which was completed in A.D. 712. It is the most important because it has preserved for us more faithfully than any other book the mythology, the manners, the language, and the traditional history of Ancient Japan. E.M. Satow, in his paper on the "Revival of Pure Shintō," says: "The Emperor Tenmu (天武天皇), at what portion of his reign is not mentioned, lamenting that the records possessed by the chief families contained many errors, resolved to take steps to preserve the true traditions from oblivion. He therefore had the records carefully examined, compared, and weeded of their faults. There happened to be in his household a person of marvellous memory named Hiyeda no Are (稗田阿礼), who could repeat without mistake the contents of any document he had ever seen, and never forgot anything that he had heard. Tenmu Tennō took the pains to instruct this person in the genuine traditions and 'old language of former ages,' and to make him repeat them until he had the whole by heart. 'Before the undertaking was completed,' which probably means before it could be committed to writing, the Emperor died, and for twenty-five years Are's memory was the sole depository of what afterwards received the title of Kojiki or Furukotobumi as it is read by Motoori (本居宣長). At the end of this interval the Empress Genmei (元明天皇) ordered Ō no Yasumaro (太安万侶) to write it down from the mouth of Are, which accounts for the completion of the manuscript in so short a time as four months and a half." (From the Translator's Introduction) One page and a few scattered sentences were translated by Basil Hall Chamberlain into Latin to preserve modesty. Cover: Communion of Sif and Uzume by cartoonist Robin Bougie (2024), released by him into the public domain. Special thanks to Rino Iwashita, a student at Akita International University, for her help with Japanese pronunciation.

The men propose to build a canoe so they can survey the island in search of other human life. Many adventures follow, one after another. They find a large chest filled with provisions and tools. Back at camp (Granite House) they find their ladder to the house has been removed--by invading orangutans. Soon the animals are defeated, except for one, whom they tame to become a house servant. The men construct a bridge over the river. They protect their abode by surrounding it on all sides with water. They undertake projects to make their colony habitable and comfortable. They create a hydraulic lift to replace the ladder. They build a seagoing boat for further exploration. I've lived on the inside of organisations where cybersecurity was taken seriously and others where it absolutely wasn't. I know what the difference looks like, and I know what it costs.
This podcast exists because the conversation about cybersecurity keeps happening at the wrong level. Every week, I sit down with CEOs, board members and business leaders to talk about what it actually takes to build an organisation that won't be taken out by a breach, a scam or a supply chain failure. No jargon, no scare tactics, no technical rabbit holes. Just honest conversations about leadership, accountability and what a cyber-first culture looks like in practice.
If you run a business and you've quietly wondered whether you're doing enough, this is the podcast for you. And if your answer is "my IT team handles that", then it's especially the podcast for you.

Just here, and doing pretty okay. It's a calm, funny antidote to hustle culture, for anyone who's ever hit an ordinary Tuesday and quietly wondered, "is this it?" — and wants the answer to be: yeah, and that's plenty.

No gurus. No morning routines. No "crush your goals." Just short, honest episodes — about five minutes each — that take the pressure to be exceptional and let a little air out of it.

One thing to be clear about: ordinary isn't lazy. This isn't a case for doing less. It's a case for pointing everything you've got at what actually matters — the people, the craft, the quiet Tuesday — instead of at a scoreboard that never stops moving.

title: Heal Deeper: Sex Addiction, Pornography, and Betrayal Trauma Recovery - Stop Just Cutting the Crabgrass
author: Dr Chris Samuels
description:
Heal Deeper is a podcast dedicated to moving beyond surface-level conversations around sex addiction, pornography, betrayal, and relationships. Rather than focusing solely on behaviour management or temporary sobriety, this podcast explores what true, lasting repair actually requires.

At its heart, the project is about helping people understand the deeper roots beneath compulsive sexual behaviours, relational pain, secrecy, shame, and disconnection. We are shifting the conversation away from simply managing symptoms and toward meaningful healing that addresses the biological, emotional, psychological, cultural, and relational factors driving these patterns.

This podcast acknowledges that addiction does not happen in isolation, and neither does healing. Through honest conversations, professional insight, lived experiences, and compassionate education, listeners will be guided through the complexities of recovery, betrayal trauma, rebuilding trust, emotional regulation, intimacy, attachment, and reconnection.

Heal Deeper is designed to support not only individuals struggling with compulsive behaviors, but also partners, couples, and practitioners seeking a deeper understanding of the recovery journey.
The goal is not simply to help people stop the behaviour.
The goal is to help people understand the roots beneath the behaviour so healing can occur at a deeper level.

Because healing is not about continually cutting back the visible symptoms.

It is about addressing what keeps growing underneath.

title: The Undeniable Podcast
author: JOHN WILLIAMS
description: The Undeniable Podcast explores the mindset, leadership principles, and performance habits that separate high achievers from everyone else. Through candid conversations and elaborate dissection of concepts with elite performers, coaches, entrepreneurs, and thought leaders, each episode equips listeners with practical strategies to build clarity, raise their standards, and become undeniable in every area of life.

title: The Financial Madrina Podcast
author: Sara
description:
Welcome to The Financial Madrina: the podcast where mental health meets money.


Hosted by Sara Diaz, a Certified Financial Social Worker and Financial Wellness Coach, The Financial Madrina helps first-generation professionals heal their relationship with money and build lasting financial wellness.


Bi-weekly we will explore the connection between mental health and finances through honest conversations about money stories, financial trauma, cultural expectations, generational wealth, and practical strategies to help you build healthier financial habits.


If you're ready to break generational cycles, rewrite your money story, and create a life of financial confidence and freedom, you're in the right place. Because building wealth starts with healing.

title: Nerdy About Nature
author: Nerdy About Nature
description:
Hosted by Ross Reid, Nerdy About Nature is a passion project that creates fun, educational content with the aim of inspiring folks to engage with the outdoor world, to fall in love with it, and to advocate on it's behalf so that we can create a more inclusive, diverse, equitable, and just future for us all.
From a 'Podchat' series that interviews experts in their field to the 'Undercurrent' news updates and everything in between, full of fun fact to make your time outside more fun.
Visit NerdyAboutNature.com or @NerdyAboutNature on social media for more videos & ways to support this project.

title: The Milky Ministries Podcast
author: Just B. Spriggs
description: Discover nourishment for your soul, one drop at a time. The Milky Ministries Podcast is your space for spiritual growth, healing, and empowerment through God’s Word. Designed for faith-driven moms and entrepreneurs, each episode dives into biblical truths, personal stories, and practical strategies to help you balance life, business, and purpose with grace. Join us as we embrace God’s plan, heal from past wounds, and step boldly into our calling.

title: LIVE from the Stacks
author: Salted Logic
description:
LIVE from the Stacks: Ku'oko a as Practice gathers artists, storytellers, and cultural stewards to reflect on independence as a living practice, not just a political destination. Held among the stacks of Native Books, this event invites conversation about how creativity and art can transform our communities.

This event is not only a reflection of independence, but of interdependence. The event aligns with the exhibit 'Off the Wall at Arts & Letters, featuring rare and out-of-print books, emphasizing how the written word is both artifact and act of preservation. Together, the conversation and exhibit ask: how do story and sovereignty meet — on the shelf, in the studio, in our homes?

title: A ENFERMAGEM NA JORNADA CONTRA O CÂNCER
author: Band Minas
description:
Da descoberta do câncer aos momentos mais delicados do tratamento, a enfermagem está presente em diferentes etapas da jornada do paciente no SUS. Em uma série especial de três episódios, mostramos o papel desses profissionais no acolhimento após o diagnóstico, no acompanhamento durante cirurgias, quimioterapia, radioterapia e cuidados paliativos, e também os desafios enfrentados por quem dedica a vida a cuidar.

Com relatos de pacientes, familiares e profissionais, a série destaca a importância da enfermagem para uma assistência mais segura, humanizada e qualificada — e também olha para quem está do outro lado do cuidado.

As reportagens são do repórter Pedro Jellinek, com produção de Isabella Freitas, edição de texto de Maria Fernanda Cinini e edição de áudio de Agnaldo Silva.

title: Taoism Lessons
author: Taoism Lessons
description:
Taoism Lessons brings you Taoist philosophy and Eastern wisdom made simple: the timeless teachings of Lao Tzu, the Tao Te Ching, Zhuangzi and the art of Wu Wei (effortless action) applied to modern life.


Discover Taoist lessons and ancient Chinese wisdom for inner peace, mental clarity and stress relief — Eastern philosophy explained in calm, soothing narrations perfect for reflection, meditation or sleep.


If you're looking for personal growth, mindfulness and a philosophy of life that teaches you to flow instead of struggle, you're in the right place.


🔔 New lesson every week. Subscribe and start flowing with the Tao.


"Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished." — Lao Tzu

title: Boring Science for Sleep
author: Boring Science for Sleep
description:
Boring Science for Sleep helps curious minds drift off gently with calm, cozy stories of science—making bedtime the best time to learn something new, softly, before you sleep.

If you’re looking to replace restless nights with peaceful curiosity and gentle rest, you’re in the right place. Hit subscribe, put on your headphones, and let Boring Science for Sleep help you find a softer path to slumber—one cozy science story at a time.

title: Big Songs. Bigger Questions
author: Big Questionnaire
description:
Songs everyone heard. Nobody was listening.

Every big pop song is a confession that got mistaken for entertainment. Someone tells the truth about the worst thing that happened to them, sets it to a beat, and a million people sing along without hearing a word.

Big Songs, Bigger Questions takes one of those songs at a time — the ones you danced to at weddings, the ones stuck in your head since you were a teenager — and asks the bigger question underneath it. Can fast love ease the mind? Is it better to need no one? Who are you pretending to be? What did that song teach you about love, and was any of it true?

Fifteen minutes. One song. One question worth sitting with.

New episodes weekly.

title: Menopause - The Real Deal
author: Michelle Rowlinson
description: "Menopause - The Real Deal" is your go-to podcast for honest, expert-driven conversations about perimenopause and menopause. Hosted by Michelle, a senior Physiotherapist, Menopause Wellbeing Practitioner, and best selling author, this podcast dives deep into the real experiences of women navigating this transformative stage of life. Each episode features insightful interviews with health professionals, business leaders, corporate women, and past clients who share their journeys, challenges, and triumphs. We debunk common myths, explore the impact of menopause on health and work life, and provide practical advice to help you manage symptoms and thrive. Whether you’re approaching perimenopause, in the midst of it, or supporting someone who is, "Menopause - The Real Deal" offers the education and support you need to embrace this phase with confidence.

title: Deejay Dlala Cheezy - Echoes Of Rhythm
author: Amogelang Buthelezi
description:
Growing up in Soweto, Deejay Cheezy watched DJs move crowds and knew that would be him. With free mentorship from Ta'Chilli, he cut his teeth playing 1-year-old birthday parties and low-budget weddings — no gig too small. Today, he's a resident at The Balcony Shisa & Chill, where he's found his true sound: Soulful House. Calm, collected, spiritually moving. This is the journey.

Each month, head curator and programmer Jameson Oyer and senior director of creative content Alicia Lu invite you to deep dive into one unforgettable film. Learn the outrageous backstory, dissect astounding premises, and watch the film’s most jaw-dropping clips. If you love movies that immediately make you want to tell your friends—or better yet, show them—this series is for you.


Stream the titles discussed and check out the full library at kinofilmcollection.com.

title: Pursuing Joy with Trent Roseman
author: Redeemer City Church
description:
Pursuing Joy is a weekly podcast exploring biblical truth, cultural issues, and everyday life through the lens of Scripture.


Each Friday, Pastor Trent Roseman offers thoughtful conversations on topics like theology, preaching, church membership, prayer, counseling, missions, apologetics, Christian living, and the questions shaping the church today. Along the way, you'll also hear interviews with pastors, missionaries, authors, ministry leaders, and other faithful voices about the work God has called them to and what Christians can learn from their experiences.


Whether we're discussing difficult passages of Scripture, responding to cultural trends, or reflecting on what God is doing around the world, every episode is driven by one conviction: lasting joy is found in knowing Christ and seeing all of life through His Word.

title: Sleepy history channel
author: Sleepy history Channel
description:
Welcome to The Sleepy History Channel — where ancient stories whisper and time fades into dreams.

Drift into slumber as we explore the quiet mysteries of the past. From the rise and fall of empires to the forgotten marvels of lost civilizations, every episode is crafted to soothe your mind with calm narration, immersive storytelling, and fascinating historical detail. Whether it’s the secrets of the Sumerians, the myths of the Maya, or the daily life of ancient Rome, our sleepy facts will gently guide you through the ages.

Perfect for curious minds who want to learn while they rest, this channel is your nighttime portal to history’s most captivating corners — told with rhythm, care, and a voice made for sleep.

Subscribe and let the past carry you peacefully into the night

The show for anyone who used to be the person they want to be again.
Hosted by Maximus Ramminger, fitness coach and founder of Gladiator Academy. Real, raw conversations on fat loss, mindset, masculinity, relationships, business, and faith.
No magic pills. No quick fixes. No motivational fluff.
If you used to be fit, confident, and dialed in, and somewhere in the climb you lost yourself, this show is for you.
You can build it back. But it’s going to take the hard work you’ve been avoiding.
New episodes weekly. Follow @maximus.ramminger on IG.

description:
Welcome to Psalms for the Soul, a weekly Torah study podcast where we journey through the timeless wisdom, heartfelt prayers, and inspiring songs found in the Book of Psalms.

Each episode explores a psalm verse by verse, uncovering its historical context, biblical truth, and practical application for everyday life. Whether you're seeking peace in difficult seasons, encouragement for your faith, or a deeper understanding of G-d's Word, these studies will help you discover the hope, comfort, and strength found in the Torah.

 Join us as we explore the Book of Psalms's inspired collection of prayers, praises, and poetry, discovering timeless truths that nourish the soul.

title: The Nosebleed Broker

description:
Whether you’re sitting in the nosebleed section or standing under the brightest lights in sports, everyone sees the game differently.

I’m Kevin, your Sports Connect — connecting the fans, the athletes, the business, and the stories that shape the sports world.

From the highest seats with a full bird’s-eye view of the entire operation to the front row where the spotlight can blind you, The Nosebleed Broker breaks down sports beyond the scoreboard.

We dive into the controversies, decisions, culture, and behind-the-scenes moves that impact the games we love.

Because it doesn’t matter where you sit — every perspective matters, and every story has more than one angle.

title: The Infinity Effect Podcast
author: Mike Brown
description:
Welcome to The Infinity Effect Podcast.

After years in the real estate industry, we've learned one important truth: this business isn't really about houses—it's about people. Every transaction represents a major life moment: a first home, a growing family, a fresh start, an investment in the future, or sometimes navigating life's most difficult transitions.

We've had the privilege of watching real estate professionals serve others in extraordinary ways, changing lives one relationship and one closing at a time. That's the Infinity Effect—the ripple created when people lead with service, show up for their communities, and put others first.

This podcast is a place to share those stories and hear from the people who are boots on the ground every day—Realtors, lenders, title professionals, and community leaders—about what it truly means to serve, make an impact, and create lasting change through real estate.

Welcome to The Infinity Effect: Conversations with Real People Shaping Our Real Estate Community.

Samtalen är personliga, reflekterande och ibland humoristiska. Ämnena varierar och styrs lika mycket av egna funderingar som av lyssnarnas inspel.

title: Find Your Authentic Energy with Human Design
author: Wendy McCauley Brand
description:
You've done everything you were 'supposed' to do. Built the career. Raised the kids. Showed up for everyone. And somewhere along the way, you lost track of yourself.

Find Your Authentic Energy with Human Design is for women who are ready to stop performing and start coming home to who they actually are. Host Wendy McCauley Brand brings together real conversations, Human Design insights, and honest reflection to help women in their 40s, 50s and 60s rediscover their strengths, trust themselves again, and do work that actually feels like them without betraying themselves in the process.

title: The Data Said What It Said
author: Julexus & Sekani
description: The Data Said What It Said is a spicy, side‑eye‑friendly education podcast where two instructional coaches pull apart education research, drag bad data gently, and ask what actually works for real kids in real classrooms. Receipts, context, and a little chaos, every episode.

title: Whisker Wise Organized Pet Care with Dr. Jennie Marvelle

description: The Whisker Wise Organized Pet Care Podcast is your go-to resource for raising happy, healthy pets with confidence. Hosted by Dr. Jennie Marvelle, a licensed veterinarian and creator of the Whisker Wise Lifespan Pet Planner, each episode delivers honest, practical guidance for real pet parents at every stage of the journey. From bringing home your first puppy to navigating the golden years of a beloved senior pet, the show combines professional expertise with genuine heart. Because every pet deserves a well-planned life and every pet parent deserves to feel ready for it.

title: The Vinyl Society
author: The Vinyl Society
description:
Welcome to The Vinyl Society Podcast—the show for vinyl collectors, music lovers, and anyone searching for their next unforgettable record.
Each episode explores the stories behind legendary albums, iconic artists, independent record stores, and the passionate people keeping vinyl culture alive. From jazz, blues, rock, soul, and beyond, we dive into the albums worth owning, the best pressings to seek out, hidden musical gems, and the record shops every collector should visit.
You'll hear conversations with record store owners, collectors, musicians, label founders, and fellow music fans who believe listening to an album should be an experience—not just background noise.
Whether you're just starting your collection or have thousands of records on your shelves, The Vinyl Society Podcast will help you discover great music, support independent record stores, and deepen your appreciation for the art of listening.
Start your free 7-day trial at Vinyl Society and discover your next favorite record.

The Human Edge is a podcast about recovery, health, and what it takes to feel your best — brought to you by Oxydise. Each episode brings together leading experts, practitioners, and everyday people to explore the science of recovery, from hyperbaric oxygen and red light therapy to sleep, movement, and mindset, alongside the real stories of people taking a more active role in their own wellbeing. Whether you're managing a long-term health condition or simply want to understand how to support your body better, The Human Edge offers clear, considered conversations to help you feel informed, reassured, and in control. Recovery, redefined.

title: Range to Ridge - Adventures with Kim Rose
author: Kim Rose Nadeau
description: Range to Ridge: Adventures with Kim Rose is where the stories get a little longer, the conversations go a little deeper, and you hear about the parts that don't always make it onto social media.  From competitive shooting and days at the range to hunting, fishing, backroads, family traditions, and life outdoors in Northern Canada, this podcast is about learning as we go and sharing the stories that come with it.  I'll take you behind the scenes of matches, hunts, adventures, wins, mistakes, lessons learned, and probably a few things that didn't go remotely according to plan. We'll talk shooting and hunting techniques, gear and preparation, outdoor skills, the people I've met along the way, and the traditions and communities that keep this lifestyle alive.  I'm not here pretending to know everything. I'm here because I love learning, asking questions, trying things, getting better, and sharing what I learn along the way.  Some episodes will teach you something. Some will tell a story. Some might make you want to grab your rifle, fishing rod, or truck keys and go make a few stories of your own.  This is Range to Ridge.  Aim True | Live Wild.

title: When Trust Turns Tragic Podcast
author: Latasha Dixon
description:
When Trust Turns Tragic explores the real stories behind betrayal, toxic relationships, dangerous friendships, and complicated family dynamics. As many of you know from Real Talk Tasha, these are the kinds of conversations I've always been passionate about.

Each episode takes a deeper look at true crime cases where trust was shattered, warning signs were missed, and the people closest to that person became part of the tragedy. We examine the psychology, manipulation, motives, and relationship dynamics that help explain how these heartbreaking cases unfolded. This is what happens when trust turns tragic.

title: New Era Reseller
author: Brian and Robin Joy Olson
description:
New Era Reseller is the podcast for regular people who want to build a real income using arbitrage strategies, without gimmicks, gurus, or guesswork. Each week we break down the moves that work right now: how to find products that actually sell, how to read the data so you stop guessing, and how to price and restock for steady profit.

But this is not only about the numbers. Building a business builds you. So alongside the tactics we talk about the habits, mindset, and small daily wins that turn a side hustle into something that lasts.

This is for people who want to build a predictable, sustainable, scalable source of income, without feeling like they are putting money into a slot machine. No hacks. No tricks. Just real business principles, and a practical playbook for building a business, and a life, you are proud of.

New episodes every week. Follow so you never miss one.

Music 101 is where every beat tells a story. Journey through the fascinating world of music as we explore the artists, genres, albums, instruments, songwriting, production, and cultural movements that have shaped the soundtrack of our lives. From the timeless masterpieces of classical music and jazz to the revolutionary sounds of rock, pop, hip-hop, country, electronic, and world music, each episode uncovers the stories, creativity, and passion behind the songs we love.
Discover the lives of legendary musicians, the origins of iconic genres, the evolution of recording technology, and the moments in history that transformed the music industry forever. author: Jericho
description:
Welcome to the Rise’N Shine Podcast—a community centered on faith in Jesus Christ and supporting one another through life's toughest trials.


​We believe that our challenges, tribulations, and hard seasons aren't in vain. Often, God allows us to go through difficult moments so that we can be the answer to someone else's prayer and help them navigate their own storms. Drawing from the Holy Bible, the Book of Mormon, and inspiring personal testimonies, host Jericho explores how we can find hope, healing, and purpose through Jesus Christ.

Hosted by bestselling author Elizabeth Hamilton-Guarino, who proudly calls Maine home, each episode celebrates the people, places, traditions, flavors, and unforgettable experiences that make Vacationland unlike anywhere else. From iconic lobster shacks and charming coastal towns to hidden waterfalls, scenic drives, local businesses, blueberry fields, bookstores, festivals, wildlife, and breathtaking adventures, 207 Vibes explores the very best of Maine—one story at a time. Whether you call Maine home, spend your summers here, dream of visiting, or simply carry a piece of Maine in your heart, you'll discover inspiring stories, local favorites, travel ideas, and conversations that capture the spirit of the Pine Tree State. This isn't just a travel podcast. It's a celebration of the places we return to, the people we remember, the traditions we cherish, and the feeling that keeps calling us back. So grab a cup of coffee, settle in, and come explore the state we all love. Welcome to 207 Vibes—The Podcast for People Who Love Maine. Because Maine is our happy place.

We tackle the topics most people avoid, from communication and intimacy to trust, heartbreak, and what it really takes to build a healthy relationship.


Shay Unfiltered also shines a light on men’s mental health, creating a space where men can be heard, understood, and encouraged to speak openly without judgment.


Whether you’re single, dating, married, or somewhere in between, you’ll find real talk, practical relationship advice, and thought-provoking discussions that challenge perspectives and spark meaningful conversations.


No filters. No sugarcoating. Just real conversations that matter.

Whether you're navigating a difficult season or seeking deeper connection and hope, you'll find authentic conversations that meet you where you are and inspire your next step forward.

Through original poems, reflections, guided meditations, affirmations, and prayers, each episode invites you to slow down, reconnect with your soul, and embrace healing, hope, and self-discovery. Inspired by divine love, nature, and the human spirit, this is a sacred space to remember the light that has always lived within you. Welcome home.

title: Pysch unmasked

description: Psych Unmasked is a space where silence breaks and emotions speak. Hosted by Zainab, a passionate psychology student shaped by her own unseen struggles, this podcast explores the pain we bury, the questions we avoid, and the mental battles we rarely name. Through stories, reflections, and real talk, Psych Unmasked helps you feel less alone because even the quietest minds deserve to be heard.

Through gentle guidance and powerful insights, Wendy invites you to pause, listen to your inner voice, release limiting beliefs, and step confidently into your truth—because everything you need is already within you.

title: The Guiding Parent Podcast: With You on the Journey
author: Tammy Ulrich and Shannon Achilles
description: The Guiding Parent Podcast is for parents who want to raise confident, resilient children through greater connection, calm, and intention. Hosted by mother-daughter duo Tammy and Shannon, each episode blends expert parenting insights with honest conversations about the everyday challenges families face. Together, they share practical tools and compassionate guidance to help you better understand your child, respond with confidence, and navigate parenting with more ease, peace, and joy. Because parenting isn't about being perfect—it's about embracing a mindset that helps both you and your child thrive.

The Innovation Podcast explores the ideas, technologies, and people shaping the future. Each episode features insightful conversations with entrepreneurs, innovators, business leaders, creators, and industry experts who are transforming the way we live and work.
From artificial intelligence and startups to leadership, productivity, and breakthrough discoveries, we dive into the stories behind innovation and the lessons that inspire progress.
Whether you're an entrepreneur, a tech enthusiast, a student, or simply curious about the future, The Innovation Podcast delivers fresh perspectives, practical insights, and inspiring conversations to keep you informed and motivated.

description:

title: Ask the Experts with Terrence Wall
author: 1310 WIBA (WIBA-AM)
description:
Join Terrence Wall of T. Wall Investments every Friday morning at 8:30 AM for an engaging discussion on real estate investing and wealth-building strategies.
Each week, Terrence explores a new and timely topic, sharing insights drawn from decades of experience in commercial real estate and investment management. Discover why brick-and-mortar real estate assets have historically provided stability and long-term value, while intangible assets such as stocks and bonds can be subject to significant market volatility.
Learn how real estate investing can help create a more diversified, secure, and resilient investment portfolio. From equity investments to promissory notes, Terrence breaks down the opportunities available to investors and discusses potential benefits such as quarterly cash distributions after stabilization, long-term appreciation, and depreciation-related tax advantages, depending on individual investment goals and circumstances.
You'll also hear about the innovative T. Wall Investments investor portal, which provides secure, 24/7 access to investment documents, performance data, tax forms, property information, and new investment opportunities from any device.
Tune in each Friday to gain valuable insights, expand your investing knowledge, and explore opportunities in commercial real estate.

twallinvestments.com

title: Android FRP & Tech Unlocks

Learn about FRP bypass methods, Google account verification tools, safe APK installations, and mobile repairs in simple, easy-to-understand language. Subscribe now to stay updated with the latest Android security patches and fixes!

title: Surfing Your Edge: Where Fear and Possibility Meet
author: Kristine Goad
description:
Surfing Your Edge is the personal growth podcast for people who know they’re meant for more—but don’t want a life that only looks good on paper.
Hosted by Kristine Goad, the Surfing Your Edge Coach, each episode brings honest conversations, personal stories, and practical insights to help you transform your relationship with fear, trust yourself more deeply, and experiment your way into a bigger, bolder, more badass life.
Together, you’ll explore courage, confidence, reinvention, and what it means to prioritize joy, wonder, peace, purpose, and possibility in rapidly changing, often chaotic times.
This isn’t about chasing perfection or fixing yourself. It’s about making friends with fear, surfing the edge of your comfort zone, and becoming more fully who you were born to be.

title: Energy Transition Desk with Lisa Wood
author: Lisa Wood
description:
The Energy Transition Desk with Lisa Wood is the insider podcast for entrepreneurs, investors, energy executives, and policymakers navigating the hard work of bringing new technology to market.

Host Lisa Wood brings decades of experience in the power sector, including 15 years leading EEI’s Institute for Electric Innovation. Now a strategic advisor to clean energy startups and venture investors, Lisa covers the full energy transition — clean power, natural gas, and the messy space where new technology meets the market.

Each episode features candid peer-level conversations with the founders, investors, energy executives, and policymakers doing the hard work of commercializing energy technology. What’s working, what’s not, and what it really takes to succeed in one of the most complex markets in the world. New episodes every other week!

title: Unfiltered Faith with Afiya
author: Afiyaunfiltered
description: Life isn’t filtered, and neither are these conversations. Welcome to Unfiltered Faith with Afiya, where faith meets real life. Hosted by Afiya J, this podcast is a space for honest conversations about faith, relationships, dating, singleness, healing, purpose, personal growth, leadership, motherhood, and navigating life’s highs and lows. Whether you’re rebuilding, becoming, or simply looking for encouragement, you’ll find practical wisdom, authentic stories, and conversations that challenge you to grow while staying grounded in your faith. Come as you are there’s a seat for you here.

title: The Whigham School Podcast
author: Steve Whigham and Jeremy Patterson, PhD
description:
The Whigham School Podcast explores how education must evolve to prepare leaders for the future.


Through conversations with founder Steve Whigham, Dr. Jeremy Patterson, educators, global thinkers, and changemakers, the podcast examines how learning can move beyond traditional classrooms to cultivate global awareness, cultural intelligence, moral courage, and a commitment to meaningful impact.

The Whigham School is a graduate-level Global Studies program redefining education through immersive, real-world experiences across six continents and more than 40 countries. Rather than focusing solely on information, it is designed to form leaders who understand the world deeply and are equipped to engage it with wisdom and purpose.


Inspired by the mission of The Whigham School and the leadership philosophy behind Steve Whigham’s book, The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow, this podcast invites future students, educators, parents, executives, and purpose-driven leaders to consider a deeper question:


What if education was designed not just to inform, but to transform?


The Whigham School Podcast is for those who believe the future of education must shape leaders marked by wisdom, humility, courage, cultural understanding, and a commitment to doing substantial good in the world.


About The Whigham School

The Whigham School is a graduate-level Global Studies program designed to develop culturally intelligent, globally experienced leaders through immersive learning across six continents and more than 40 countries.


The mission is to encourage a new generation of global leaders to do substantial good in the world.


Built around global understanding, global leadership, and global benevolence, The Whigham School prepares students to navigate complexity, engage across cultures, and use their education, profession, and influence as a force for human flourishing.


Students do more than study the world. They learn to understand it, engage with it, and help shape it.


For more information, please visit https://whighamschool.org/


About The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow


The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow by Steve Whigham helps illuminate the kind of leadership philosophy at the heart of The Whigham School.


The book explores the character, courage, wisdom, and moral imagination needed for the future — offering a framework for leaders who want to move beyond self-interest and contribute to something larger than themselves.


Together, The Whigham School and The Leader’s Guide to Tomorrow reflect a shared belief:


The world does not suffer from a lack of intelligence, ambition, or resources.

It suffers from a lack of courageous, morally grounded leadership.


For information, please visit https://thetomorrowleader.com/

title: Trust Control
author: Kate Kaye
description: Trust Control is a documentary podcast series about the weird yet surprisingly expansive world of trust measurement from investigative journalist and researcher Kate Kaye. Based on nearly a year of deep research and interviews with a wide variety of sources, the show takes listeners on a journey from the post-World War II Cold War period into the early days of the Internet through to today's agentic AI era. Trust – how it is measured, by whom and for what purposes – is the thread that carries us along throughout. Episodes dig into measurement of trust in AI and automation; media, news and information trustworthiness; the emerging realm of human and AI agent "worker" trust scoring, U.S. military and corporate management funding and influence in trust measurement, and more. Part historical documentary, part philosophical analysis, part provocative (and admittedly hokey) satire, Trust Control explores an emerging trust paradigm happening just below the surface of our digital lives… bubbling up to the surface of our real ones.

Veteran Omaha Magazine executive Gil Cohen takes you behind the scenes with the people shaping our city — from mayors to musicians, CEOs to community advocates. title: Vasectomy Clinics Of Chicago with Dr George Tsoutsias
author: Vasectomy Clinics of Chicago
description:
This channel is for the man who has already made his decision. His family is complete, or he and his partner know children aren't part of their future. 


But he can't seem to get past what he's read online. He's been through the Reddit threads. He's heard the stories from a buddy who had a rough time. 


And instead of getting clearer, he's gotten more anxious. He's looking for a physician who will tell him the truth about what a vasectomy actually is, what it actually does, and what to expect from someone who has done this thousands of times.


Vasectomy Clinics of Chicago has performed more than 30,000 vasectomies across five Chicagoland locations. Their physicians (board-certified surgeons who have dedicated their practice exclusively to this procedure) have seen one pattern more than any other: the fear is almost always larger than the reality. 


Nearly every nervous patient says the same thing on the way out: "That was so much easier than I expected." This channel exists to close that gap before the appointment, replacing what the internet gets wrong with what 30,000 cases actually teach you.

title: Diaries of a Fashion Stylist

title: Sex & Porn Addiction Recovery with Russell Beebe
author: Russell Beebe
description:
How To Overcome Porn, Lust & Other Compulsive Sexual Behaviors In 90 Days! 👇 

https://wellnessseekersultd.com/youtube


You swore you were done. You deleted the apps, blocked the sites, made the promise again. Then it happened anyway.


If you are a man caught in the cycle of pornography or sex addiction and you are done cycling through relapse, shame, and broken promises, you are in the right place.


This Podcast breaks down why willpower fails, why weekly therapy alone often is not enough, and what actually creates lasting sexual sobriety. You will learn how to stop the relapse cycle, manage urges without white knuckling it, rebuild trust in your relationships, and heal the emotional patterns driving the behavior.


No shame. No lectures about being a bad person. A real, structured recovery process from a Certified Sex Addiction Therapist who has helped hundreds of men recover from porn and sex addiction in 12 weeks, not years.


New Episodes on porn addiction recovery, sex addiction help, betrayal trauma, and rebuilding trust after infidelity.
